title: Sunday · the Legacy on 101
logline: The wagon on 101 in October from the bluff, the blue haze from the tailpipe drawn faithfully, the sea. A car as a landscape.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Highway 101 curving along the bluff above the sea in October, and on it, small, a faded green wagon with a faint blue haze behind it.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a coastal highway curving along a bluff above the sea in autumn with a small faded green station wagon trailing a faint blue exhaust haze, no words
image.notes: The haze is canon: every driving panel.

panels.name: Bend

panels.composition: Tier 2: the side mirror, close, with the road behind in it and the haze.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a car's side mirror close up reflecting a coastal road and a faint blue haze, no words

panels.name: Mirror

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sea from the road, gray-green, the horizon. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, the sea seen from a coastal highway in gray-green wash with a soft horizon, no words

panels.name: Sea

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: A car as a landscape. The haze faithful.
